preconditions.description: The number of servers n must be between 1 and 500,000.
The number of connections m must be between 0 and the minimum of n(n-1)/2 and 500,000.
The parameter k must be between 0 and 60.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= c_i <= (1 << k) - 1 for c_i in c)
preconditions.description: Each encryption key c_i must be within the range from 0 to 2^k - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n and u_i != v_i for u_i, v_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each connection must involve valid server indices and cannot connect a server to itself.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of safe infections modulo 10^9 + 7.
